subject.title: [Feature]: Expose an inbound non-message event hook to external channel plugins (e.g. reactions)

question: Should external channel plugins surface non-message activity through the existing system-event/inbound-runner APIs, or should OpenClaw add a new public channel event hook, adapter slot, or dispatch contract?
rationale: Current main exposes partial primitives, but choosing documentation, a dispatch API, or a new adapter/hook affects the public plugin SDK contract and overlaps with open reaction/hook work.

options.title: Document current system-event path
options.body: Treat reactions and similar notifications as routed system events, document the plugin recipe, and only add code if that recipe proves insufficient.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow event contract
options.body: Define a typed plugin SDK hook, adapter, or runEvent API for non-message inbound activity and align it with the related inbound_activity and reaction-hook proposals.

options.title: Wait for plugin proof
options.body: Ask for a minimal Zoho Cliq plugin sketch showing why system events and runChannelInboundEvent cannot solve the use case.

recommendation.title: Document current system-event path
recommendation.body: Treat reactions and similar notifications as routed system events, document the plugin recipe, and only add code if that recipe proves insufficient.

likelyOwner.reason: He has broad recent history in the plugin runtime/channel boundary and is the best available routing owner for the SDK direction choice.
